entity.name: João Carvalho
entity.description: Independent developer in São Paulo, Brazil. I build and maintain Open World Clock on my own, and keep it free, open source and free of ads and telemetry.

projects.name: Open World Clock
projects.description: A free, open source world clock for Windows 10 and 11, made for working with people in other time zones. Your cities side by side, type a time or scroll any clock and every city converts, a meeting planner that finds the hours when everyone is working, and a live day and night map. English, Portuguese and Spanish, keyboard and screen reader support. No ads, no account, no telemetry, works offline. A web version runs on openworldclock.com and a native iPhone app is in progress. Funding goes to maintenance, code signing, the iPhone app and accessibility work.
